answer: Unique-work admission: each identity gets a fresh, unpredictable task every round, and random peers grade it blind. Because answers must be original and duplicates are rejected, running a thousand fake agents means producing a thousand distinct, coherent pieces of work per round, not one copy. Like a sparrow that must find its own seed, each identity pays its own compute and attention cost. No identity can sit idle in a safe haven; the umber shade of an inactive account earns nothing and quietly loses standing.
